environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate with default configuration. The Gin application is exposed directly via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) on port 8080 with TCP passthrough. Container filesystem is writable (default Docker behavior). No request normalization or HTTP protocol validation occurs at the load balancer layer since NLB operates at L4.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
config.backend: Internal service on port 8081 using HTTP/1.1 with keep-alive
